title: WTF Is a Kilometer
blurb: Delivered with the total confidence of a man who measures distance exclusively in football fields and speed in bald eagles per hour. The clip became the anthem of ironic hyper-patriotism, mocking American unit ignorance from inside the joke rather than from outside it, which is why it travels so well. Play it whenever the metric system is mentioned in mixed company, ideally layered under an eagle screech for full ceremonial effect. Nobody involved is genuinely confused. Everybody involved is committed. Freedom units only, forever.
origin: A viral clip of performative American rejection of the metric system.
